params.score: segment max CHM, min-max normalized to [0,1] per tile

note: Greedy matching F1 at IoU 0.5, identical harness for all arms. Labels are hand-labeled center+diameter eyeball estimates on leaf-off 2022 8cm ortho; not survey-grade.

method.data_source: NRCan CanElevation LiDAR Point Clouds S3 (https://canelevation-lidar-point-clouds.s3.ca-central-1.amazonaws.com), supplier TRCA, project GTA_2023, 20230511 capture, Open Government Licence - Canada
method.classification: vendor-classified: ground(2), building(6), unassigned(1), low point(7), high noise(18); NO vegetation classes -> buildings dropped from DSM, vegetation arrives via unassigned class 1
method.building_mask: City of Toronto 'Topographic Mapping - Building Outlines' (CKAN 09a930cc..., 557,694 outlines, DERIVED_HEIGHT from LiDAR), rasterized at 0.5 m with 2 m buffer; masked to nan in CHM BEFORE segmentation. Double defense: class-6 points also excluded from DSM.
method.dtm: NRCan HRDEM 1 m DTM (WCS, validated flat-ground median 0.06 m), bilinear resample to 0.5 m
method.dsm: fine max-Z scatter of class-1/vegetation points at 0.5 m (~6.9 pts/cell)
method.segmentation: classical Dalponte-style seeded region growing: Gaussian smooth -> local-maxima treetops (tallest first) -> grow to 8-neighbors only downhill, above floor, within max_radius, unclaimed. Stops at valleys between crowns; this fixes the marker-watershed failure mode (segments leaking across shallow valleys into grove-sized blobs).
method.labels: CORRECTED labels (data/labels_corrected/): the shared data/labels are 8x8 grid cells, not crowns (proven in TRACKA_REPORT.md); corrected labels are real trees verified against the 8 cm ortho. qa7 HELD OUT of tuning.
method.box_construction: axis-aligned bbox of surviving watershed segment, meters from tile top-left

baselines_for_comparison.note: Identical harness (IoU 0.5, greedy matching, threshold sweep). qa7 HELD OUT of tuning.
